```{r}
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
df <- fread(here("data", "data_clean", "country_year_sanctions_coflict_gdelt.csv"))
```


```{r}
View(df)
```


```{r}
df <- df %>%
  mutate(year = as.integer(format(as.Date(year), "%Y"))) %>%   # convert FIRST
  filter(year >= 1989) %>%                                      # then filter on real years
  group_by(gw_name) %>%
  mutate(
    mrgdppc_detrended = if (sum(!is.na(mrgdppc)) >= 3) {
      residuals(lm(mrgdppc ~ year, na.action = na.exclude))
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```


```{r}


# variables going into the PVAR — adjust this list to match your final model
pvar_vars <- c("num_sanctioners", 
               "cumulative_total_deaths_parties_in_orgvio_pc", 
               "v2x_polyarchy", 
               "mrgdppc_detrended")

# check variance of each variable, by country
var_check <- df %>%
  group_by(gw_name) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(pvar_vars), 
                    ~ var(.x, na.rm = TRUE), 
                    .names = "var_{.col}"),
            across(all_of(pvar_vars), 
                    ~ sum(!is.na(.x)), 
                    .names = "n_{.col}"))

# a country is flagged if ANY variable has near-zero variance, is all-NA, or has too few obs
flagged_units <- var_check %>%
  filter(
    if_any(starts_with("n_"), ~ .x < 10)   # insufficient data — a real problem regardless of variance
  ) %>%
  pull(gw_name)


#flagged_units <- var_check %>%
#  filter(if_any(starts_with("var_"), ~ is.na(.x) | .x < 1e-8) |
#       if_any(starts_with("n_"),   ~ .x < 15))%>%
#  pull(gw_name)


# manual exclusions (structural breaks / discontinued units)
manual_exclusions <- c("German Democratic Republic")

exclude_units <- unique(c(flagged_units, manual_exclusions))

df_clean <- df %>% 
  filter(!(gw_name %in% exclude_units))

# sanity check: how many countries survived, and who got dropped
length(unique(df$gw_name))
length(unique(df_clean$gw_name))
exclude_units
```

```{r}
head(df_clean)
```




```{r}


dep_vars <- c("num_sanctioners", 
               "cumulative_total_deaths_parties_in_orgvio_pc", 
               "v2x_polyarchy", 
               "mrgdppc_detrended")
  # ---- 1. lag selection: compare candidate lag orders via MMSC ----




lag_results <- list()

for (p in 1:3) {
  lag_results[[p]] <- pvargmm(
    dependent_vars = dep_vars,
    lags = p,
    transformation = "fod",
    data =  as.data.frame(df_clean), 
    panel_identifier = c("gw_name", "year"),
    steps = c("twostep"),
    system_instruments = FALSE,
    max_instr_dependent_vars = 4,
    min_instr_dependent_vars = 2,
    collapse = TRUE
  )
}

# compare MMSC-BIC across lag orders — pick the lowest
for (p in 1:3) {
  cat("Lags =", p, "\n")
  print(Andrews_Lu_MMSC(lag_results[[p]]))
  cat("\n")
}
```

```{r}
cor(df_clean$v2x_polyarchy, df_clean$mrgdppc_detrended, use = "complete.obs")

df_clean %>%
  arrange(gw_name, year) %>%
  group_by(gw_name) %>%
  mutate(d_v2x = v2x_polyarchy - lag(v2x_polyarchy),
         d_gdp = mrgdppc_detrended - lag(mrgdppc_detrended)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  summarise(cor_levels = cor(v2x_polyarchy, mrgdppc_detrended, use = "complete.obs"),
            cor_diffs = cor(d_v2x, d_gdp, use = "complete.obs"))
```

```{r}
# Orthogonal IRF
irf_o <- oirf(p1_lsdv_less_dem, n.ahead = 10)

# Generalized IRF (often preferred — no ordering assumption)
irf_g <- girf(p1_lsdv_less_dem, n.ahead = 10, ma_approx_steps = 10)
```


```{r}
irf_bs <- bootstrap_irf(p1_lsdv_less_dem,
                         typeof_irf = "GIRF",
                         n.ahead = 10,
                         nof_Nstar_draws = 500,
                         confidence.band = 0.95,
                         mc.cores = 4)   # adjust to your machine

girf_result <- girf(p1_lsdv_less_dem, n.ahead = 10, ma_approx_steps = 10)
plot(girf_result, irf_bs)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

p_all <- plot(girf_result, irf_bs)

# confirm the structure matches what the source code implies
head(p_all$data)

df_single <- p_all$data %>%
  filter(impulse == "cumulative_total_deaths_parties_in_orgvio_pc on num_sanctioners")

ggplot(df_single, aes(x = periods, y = value)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = Lower, ymax = Upper), alpha = 0.2, fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "Response of in conflict deaths in",
       x = "Steps ahead", y = "Response") +
  theme_minimal()
```
